AuthorDetails.Name: Daniel Schmidt
AuthorDetails.Description: Lead Engineer at Charlie Tango, working on headless Umbraco sites and the tools around them.

Title: Cache Tags
Description: Cache Delivery API responses at the frontend, and purge exactly the right ones once every Umbraco server has applied a change.

Screenshots.Caption: Follow each change from publish to purge: the keys it planned, the servers that applied it, and every purge it sent.
Search for an item, a path or a key to see which cached responses include it.
See on every document's Info tab which served responses include it, and purge it by hand.
